title: Chicken Gyro with Tzatziki
description: Marinated chicken thighs in warm pita with a cooling cucumber-yogurt tzatziki.
ingredients: Tomato and red onion to serve
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt, za'atar, garlic and lemon juice for at least 1 hour.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through, then slice.
Mix the remaining yogurt with grated cucumber for tzatziki, and build the gyros in warm pita.
notes: Thigh meat stays juicier than breast here and handles the high-heat grilling better.
